Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.lastUpdate: Last updated: August 2026 — Compliant with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)
Privacy.s2P1: pawelium is a static showcase website. We do not collect personal data through server-stored forms. The only direct interaction takes place via WhatsApp (a third-party app subject to the WhatsApp/Meta privacy policy) or by email.
Privacy.s2P2: The information you voluntarily provide to us (name, question, contact details) via WhatsApp or email is used solely to respond to your request. It is neither shared with third parties nor used for commercial purposes.
Privacy.s3P1: This site uses technical cookies strictly necessary for operation (language preference, theme). These cookies do not require consent under article 82 of the French Data Protection Act.
Privacy.s3P2: We do not use advertising cookies, cross-site tracking, or behavioural analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel.
Privacy.s4P1: The legal basis for processing is legitimate interest (responding to contact requests). Exchanges via WhatsApp or email are kept for the time necessary to process your request, and for a maximum of 3 years from the last contact.
Privacy.s5Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data:
Privacy.s5Right1: Right of access — to know what data we hold about you
Privacy.s5Right2: Right to rectification — to correct inaccurate data
Privacy.s5Right3: Right to erasure — to request the deletion of your data
Privacy.s5Outro: To exercise these rights, contact us by email. In the event of a dispute, you may refer the matter to the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
Privacy.s6P1: The site is served over HTTPS. No sensitive data is stored in the browser. WhatsApp exchanges benefit from the end-to-end encryption provided by WhatsApp/Meta.

Terms.title: Terms of Sale & Payment Policy
Terms.subtitle: Applicable to all European transactions conducted on pawelium.fyi — Last updated: November 2026
Terms.s1Text: These Terms of Sale govern the purchase and reservation of purebred companion animals (dogs, puppies, cats, and kittens) presented on the Pawelium European marketplace. By initiating checkout and settling payment, the customer enters into a binding European purchase agreement ensuring compliance with EU Regulation 576/2013 and national veterinary health standards.
Terms.s2Text: All purchases on Pawelium require immediate, full payment at the time of reservation. In accordance with strict European live-animal commerce guidelines, Pawelium does not accept deposits, partial payments, escrow holds, or installment credit plans. Orders are processed via our PCI-DSS compliant credit card payment gateway, supporting 3D-Secure authorized Visa, Mastercard and European debit and credit cards in Euros (EUR). Payment confirmation is strictly authoritative upon asynchronous banking confirmation.
Terms.s3Text: Initiating checkout creates a temporary exclusive reservation hold for 15 minutes. During this period, the animal is locked in our database and cannot be purchased by other users. If payment is not completed within 15 minutes, the hold expires automatically and the animal returns to available status. In the rare event of a late payment arriving after hold expiration and subsequent reassignment, the payment is isolated under priority dispute reconciliation and refunded without penalty.
Terms.s4Text: Every animal leaves its registered breeder with an official European pet passport, ISO 11784/11785 microchip, age-appropriate WSAVA core vaccinations, and a veterinarian-signed certificate of good health dated within 5 days of departure.
Terms.s5Text: Delivery is performed by certified animal couriers complying with European Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2005. Handover occurs directly to the designated adopter upon identity verification.
Terms.s6Text: These terms are governed by the laws of France and applicable European Union consumer and animal protection regulations. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent European commercial courts.
